gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histological diagnosis of primary, newly diagnosed supratentorial, WHO grade IV glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: 18F-Fluciclovine is an FDA-approved radioactive diagnostic agent that is injected into the patient and then taken up by cancer cells, which can then be visualized with a PET/CT scan.
To determine the effect fluciclovine PET has on definition of the tumor volume, as compared to traditional MRI-based radiotherapy.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To assess whether incorporating fluciclovine PET into radiotherapy planning significantly changes the in-field and out-of-field radiographic progression rates

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To determine the effect fluciclovine PET has on definition of the tumor volume, as compared to traditional MRI-based radiotherapy.

role_evidence.quote: 18F-Fluciclovine is FDA approved for the detection of recurrent prostate cancer, but is still investigational for the purposes of this study.

agents.agent_name_registered: TMZ (standard therapy, not a registered intervention)

role_evidence.quote: Plan to undergo standard therapy with XRT 60Gy/30fx with TMZ followed by 6-12 cycles of maintenance TMZ within 6 weeks of surgery

coder_notes: Fluciclovine is used as a PET planning/diagnostic tracer, not for antitumour effect, so no candidate. Temozolomide listed because the protocol text says every patient receives it (Stupp); it is not a registered intervention. WHO grade IV glioma without IDH requirement coded historical.
